 Domain Theme switch 
 Domain Theme Switch module for Drupal 8+ community users.

 
 This module provide the administrator interface to manage the theme. 
 The interface provide very basic setting to manage the theme

 against each domain.
 
 
 Versions 
 The 2.x branch, compatible with Domain 2.0.x , is considered feature complete and will receive bug fixes only.

 All new features will be added exclusively to the 3.x branch that requires Domain 3.0.0+ .

 Configuration 
 Domain Theme Switch module have configuration setting page

to set theme against each Domains.

 Configuration page path:

/admin/config/domain/domain_theme_switch/config
